exposure: delivery room continuous positive airway pressure (DR-CPAP) application
cohort: Neonates >=35-week gestational age who were unexposed to delivery room positive pressure ventilation or oxygen supplementation.
finding: The occurrence of CPAP-associated pneumothorax decreased after avoiding delivery room continuous positive airway pressure (DR-CPAP) in neonates >=35-week gestational age without DR-positive pressure ventilation/oxygen supplementation.
